title: Configuration Spaces of Tensegrities — Problem 1
exact_target: Describe the stratified configuration spaces for six planar vertices and for four or five spatial vertices, including their stratum combinatorics.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 6900001 (AMR-068-0001). CC BY 4.0.

Oleg Karpenkov, Jan Schepers and Brigitte Servatius, \emph{On stratifications for planar tensegrities with a small number of vertices}, arXiv:1201.3557v1 (2012), Definitions 1.1--1.3, pp. 2--3; Problem 2.7, p. 12.
